authority: Line owner 2026-10-16 production-line optimisation plan §4: see a scene's timing before anything is paid for.  The previs module (tools/episode_previs.py) existed but no pipeline stage ever called it, so every episode reached its first paid stage without a single machine check of dialogue coverage, dialogue fit, grouping coverage or speaker registration.
activation_note: Empty by default: no episode changes behaviour until it is listed here.  Gate roles, how a machine failure is treated, and the director-review round limit are set below.  A contract may opt in on its own with previs_policy="EPISODE_PREVIS_V1".
block_note: The previs gate runs at the START of each listed stage, before any manifest is built and before any POST.  It is read-only and costs nothing.  S7 (assembly) is deliberately not listed: by then the money is spent and a machine failure can only be recorded, not prevented.
machine_failure_note: Plan §4.2 machine failures are objective contract conflicts (a speaker who is not registered, a line that cannot fit its shot, an unauthorised repeated line, a shot no unit covers).  They block the paid stage.  They are never waived by the director-review round limit.

director_review.note: Plan §4.2 and §4.3: the six subjective questions are advisory.  After max_rounds anything still open is recorded as ADVISORY and the run continues; a previs PASS means the plan is internally consistent enough to go on to production, never that a cut is good.

advisory_waiver_note: A recorded advisory never becomes a gate: the round limit cannot waive a machine failure, a budget guard or a transaction check.
